answer: Let reputation grow like a vine: each agent earns voting and payout weight only after many consecutive epochs of passing, peer-graded work, and that weight is non-transferable. No one can forge age with money, so a sybil farm must keep every clone alive and honest for months before it counts. When a tide of fresh accounts floods in, their combined weight stays near zero, while the attacker pays compute for each idle clone the whole time.
